# Change request 22 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## A page for each note
- Each note has its own page at `/notes/<number>`, where `<number>` is the note's number (for example `/notes/3`).
- On the list page and on `/archive`, each note's title is a link to its page.
- The note page shows:
  - an `<h1>` with the note's current title;
  - the text `No. <number>`, and the text `Added <YYYY-MM-DD>` with a `<time>` element as on the list page;
  - the text `pinned` when the note is pinned, and the text `Archived` when it is archived;
  - a link `Back to notes` to `/notes`.
- When nobody is signed in, `/notes/<number>` redirects to `/login`.
- A user only ever reaches their own notes this way. When the signed-in user has no note with that number (it never
  existed, it was deleted, or `<number>` is not a number at all), the page responds with HTTP status 404 and shows
  the text `Note not found`. Notes shared with the user are not reachable through these pages, and these pages never
  contain other users' notes.
- The note page and the links to it also work with JavaScript disabled.

Base directory for this skill: /Users/otischen/Developer/hozu-trial-0024/hozu-cold-sonnet/app/.claude/skills/hozu

# Hozu

Hozu is not in your training data: this file and `npx hozu docs <topic>` are the whole API (skip
`node_modules/@hozu`). Diagnostics teach the other rules when you break them: apply their fix.

## The change loop
1. `npx hozu map`: the session shape, the verify line, every file's role, each declaration's `file:line`. Open
   only the lines the change touches. A new app: `npx hozu add feature <name> --page / --with …`, then
   `npx hozu docs feature`.
2. Edit everything the change needs (table below).
3. `npx hozu check` once. For an intended behaviour change, `npx hozu check --update-lock`, then list the accepted
   `now:` lines in your summary.
4. Verify once with the line `hozu map` prints: `npx hozu browse <path> --session '…' --js both --do '…'`. It runs
   the same app as `npm start`, with and without JS; do not start a server or use `curl`.

## What to touch
| Change | Touch |
|---|---|
| UI-only state (a tab) | model: a context field, an event, an `on` whose `assign` sets it → views: the control |
| Filter / sort in the URL | the route's `search` (with a default) → `ui.link(route, params, { key })` → `search.key`; filtering while typing: `seed: ({ search }) => ({ key: search.key })`, read `ctx.key` |
| A per-item action stored on the server (pin, archive) | model: the item field, an event, a mutation that `invalidates` the list tag, `on(E, { target: 'pinning', assign: (e) => { ctx.target = e.id } })`, a state with `invoke` → views: the per-item form (`hozu docs patterns`) → app: store it, sort in the list resolver |
| A control every state handles | `machine({ on: [...] })` |
| New page | `routes.ts` → a view with `route` → `ui.page(...)` in `hozu.config.ts` |
| UI (a button, a field) | `ui.use` of a kit component; the catalog: `npx hozu docs components` |

## Rules no diagnostic checks
- **Every query and mutation states `runs`:** a database, a secret or the session → `'server'` (resolver in
  `app.ts`); the visitor's browser credentials → `'browser'`; a public API → `'either'`, implemented in the feature's
  `fetch.ts` (`npx hozu docs fetch`).
- **Query resolvers only read.** Writes belong in mutation and endpoint resolvers; a prefetched link runs queries.
- **Other users, reloads, sign-out:** verify them in one `browse` chain with `--js both` (`--as <name>` per user).
- **Contracts only where a transition decides:** a guard, a `navigate`, a `fn` or computed value. Copy-only
  transitions are reviewed in the lock.
- **`'live'` only for push** to pages that are already open.
- **`invalidates` drives the client refresh** of every query with those tags, whatever its freshness.

## Topics (`npx hozu docs <topic>`; `--more`: options, edge cases)
| Task | Topic |
|---|---|
| a new feature, the files, a complete example | `feature` |
| elements, attributes, events, lists, links, reuse | `views` |
| states, events, invoke, timers, guards | `machine` |
| queries, mutations, tags, `fn()`, resolvers | `data` |
| where effects run, `fetch.ts`, browser tokens, static hosts | `fetch` |
| contracts and the lock | `contracts` |
| routes, search, pages, `head`, 403 / 404 | `pages` |
| forms, checkboxes, bulk forms, no JS | `forms` |
| sign-in, sessions, per-user data | `auth` |
| filters, modes, per-item actions, load more | `patterns` |
| worked changes | `recipes` |
| webhooks, JSON APIs, redirects | `endpoints` |
| components, kits, browser APIs, DOM libraries | `components` |
| languages, env, HTTP, Markdown, tests, deploying, upgrading Hozu | `i18n` `env` `http` `content` `testing` `deploy` |
| a diagnostic code | `diagnostics` |
| change requests from Hozu DevTools (`.hozu/requests`) | `requests` |

# Routes and pages

```ts
// routes.ts
export const home = route({ path: '/', params: null, search: z.object({ show: Show.default('all') }) })
export const itemPage = route({ path: '/items/:id', params: z.object({ id: z.string() }), search: null })
export const docs = route({ path: '/docs/:path+', params: z.object({ path: z.array(z.string()).min(1) }), search: null })
```
- `:x` one segment, `:x?` optional (nullable), `:x+` / `:x*` one-or-more / zero-or-more (string[]) (HZ024).
- `search`: flat scalars or enums, each with a default or nullable (HZ035).
- **Pages** go in `project({ routes: { home, itemPage }, pages: [...] })` (the whole config: see --more):
  `ui.page(home, { views: [Board], head: { render: () => ({ title: 'Items' }) } })`.
- **Head from a query:** `head: { query: getItem, input: (params) => ({ id: params.id }), render: (item) => ({ title:
  item.title }), failed: { NotFound: 404 } }`. `failed` maps every declared error of the query (HZ051) to a route
  without params (303) or to `403`, `404` or `410`.
- `head.render` fields: `title`, `description`, `type` (`'website' | 'article'`), `image`, `published`, `noindex`.
- A route no page renders is HZ052.

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs pages --more

# Routes and pages

```ts
// routes.ts
export const home = route({ path: '/', params: null, search: z.object({ show: Show.default('all') }) })
export const itemPage = route({ path: '/items/:id', params: z.object({ id: z.string() }), search: null })
export const docs = route({ path: '/docs/:path+', params: z.object({ path: z.array(z.string()).min(1) }), search: null })
```
- `:x` one segment, `:x?` optional (nullable), `:x+` / `:x*` one-or-more / zero-or-more (string[]) (HZ024).
- `search`: flat scalars or enums, each with a default or nullable (HZ035).
- **Pages** go in `project({ routes: { home, itemPage }, pages: [...] })` (the whole config: see --more):
  `ui.page(home, { views: [Board], head: { render: () => ({ title: 'Items' }) } })`.
- **Head from a query:** `head: { query: getItem, input: (params) => ({ id: params.id }), render: (item) => ({ title:
  item.title }), failed: { NotFound: 404 } }`. `failed` maps every declared error of the query (HZ051) to a route
  without params (303) or to `403`, `404` or `410`.
- `head.render` fields: `title`, `description`, `type` (`'website' | 'article'`), `image`, `published`, `noindex`.
- A route no page renders is HZ052.

- URLs are canonical (keys sorted, defaults left out). Changing `search` is a navigation: a filter in the URL is a
  plain `ui.link`, no machine.

```ts
// hozu.config.ts
export default project({
  schema: zodAdapter, app: new URL('./app.ts', import.meta.url), styles: new URL('./app.css', import.meta.url),
  site: { url: 'https://example.com', name: 'Items', lang: 'en' },
  routes: { home, itemPage }, notFound: missing,           // notFound / error: routes rendered for 404 / 500
  pages: [
    ui.page(home, { views: [Board], head: { render: () => ({ title: 'Items' }) } }),
    ui.page(itemPage, {
      views: [Detail],
      head: {
        query: getItem,
        input: (params) => ({ id: params.id }),
        render: (item) => ({ title: item.title, description: item.title, type: 'article' }),
        failed: { NotFound: 404 },                         // every declared error of the query (HZ051)
      },
      entries: { query: listItems, input: {}, params: (item) => ({ id: item.id }) },   // sitemap + static export
    }),
  ],
  kits: [kit],                                             // shared UI (hozu docs components)
  features: [items],
})
```
- `image` is a URL, `ui.asset(...)` or `ui.og({ title })`.
- `head.failed` example: `failed: { Unauthorized: login, Forbidden: 403 }`. `Unexpected` is always 500.
  It maps declared errors only: a head query that always fails is not a redirect.
- **Which redirect** (one per purpose):

| Need | Form |
|---|---|
| a static path moved | `http.redirects` (`hozu docs http`) |
| this visitor may not see the page | `head.failed` |
| a decision on success, e.g. `/` by session | a GET endpoint with `output: 'redirect'` (`hozu docs endpoints`) |
| after a machine transition | `navigate` |

- For a route no page renders (HZ052), link to an endpoint with `ui.link(endpoint, input)` instead.
- A detail view: `ui.view({ route: itemPage, render: ({ params }) => ui.query(getItem, { id: params.id }, { ready,
  failed: { NotFound: () => ui.p({}, ['Not found']), Unexpected: () => … } }) })`.
- A page loads JS only when a machine-bound part renders on it (`hozu plan <route>`). Every link loads a document;
  state across pages lives in the URL (`seed`), on the server (queries) or in a client component's own storage.

- **Head from a query:** `head: { query: getItem, input: (params) => ({ id: params.id }), render: (item) => ({ title:
  item.title }), failed: { NotFound: 404 } }`. `failed` maps every declared error of the query (HZ051) to a route
  without params (303) or to `403`, `404` or `410`.
- `head.render` fields: `title`, `description`, `type` (`'website' | 'article'`), `image`, `published`, `noindex`.
- A route no page renders is HZ052.

- URLs are canonical (keys sorted, defaults left out). Changing `search` is a navigation: a filter in the URL is a
  plain `ui.link`, no machine.

```ts
// hozu.config.ts
export default project({
  schema: zodAdapter, app: new URL('./app.ts', import.meta.url), styles: new URL('./app.css', import.meta.url),
  site: { url: 'https://example.com', name: 'Items', lang: 'en' },
  routes: { home, itemPage }, notFound: missing,           // notFound / error: routes rendered for 404 / 500
  pages: [
    ui.page(home, { views: [Board], head: { render: () => ({ title: 'Items' }) } }),
    ui.page(itemPage, {
      views: [Detail],
      head: {
        query: getItem,
        input: (params) => ({ id: params.id }),
        render: (item) => ({ title: item.title, description: item.title, type: 'article' }),
        failed: { NotFound: 404 },                         // every declared error of the query (HZ051)
      },
      entries: { query: listItems, input: {}, params: (item) => ({ id: item.id }) },   // sitemap + static export
    }),
  ],
  kits: [kit],                                             // shared UI (hozu docs components)
  features: [items],
})
```
- `image` is a URL, `ui.asset(...)` or `ui.og({ title })`.
- `head.failed` example: `failed: { Unauthorized: login, Forbidden: 403 }`. `Unexpected` is always 500.
  It maps declared errors only: a head query that always fails is not a redirect.
- **Which redirect** (one per purpose):

| Need | Form |
|---|---|
| a static path moved | `http.redirects` (`hozu docs http`) |
| this visitor may not see the page | `head.failed` |
| a decision on success, e.g. `/` by session | a GET endpoint with `output: 'redirect'` (`hozu docs endpoints`) |
| after a machine transition | `navigate` |

- For a route no page renders (HZ052), link to an endpoint with `ui.link(endpoint, input)` instead.
- A detail view: `ui.view({ route: itemPage, render: ({ params }) => ui.query(getItem, { id: params.id }, { ready,
  failed: { NotFound: () => ui.p({}, ['Not found']), Unexpected: () => … } }) })`.
- A page loads JS only when a machine-bound part renders on it (`hozu plan <route>`). Every link loads a document;
  state across pages lives in the URL (`seed`), on the server (queries) or in a client component's own storage.

312	            ctx.editError = null

318	        on(Save, {

  Undo,

const bulk = ui.formRef()

const errorText = part((code: string) =>
  code === 'duplicate' ? text.duplicate
    : code === 'notFound' ? text.notFound
    : code === 'archived' ? text.archived
    : code === 'tooMany' ? text.tooMany
    : code === 'nothingToUndo' ? text.nothingToUndo
    : code === 'selfShare' ? text.selfShare
    : code,
)

const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,

          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50' }, [text.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),

      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded border bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                  ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, ['Deleted "', deleted.title, '"']),
                  ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, {}) } }, [
                    ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [text.undo]),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (all) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.count({ count: all.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', role: 'search', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                id: 'notes-search',
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': text.search,

                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [text.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              'Showing ',

1	import type { Implement } from '@hozu/data'
2	import { adminUsers, addNote, exportNotes, archiveNote, archiveNotes, removeNotes, lastDeleted, listArchived, listNotes, removeNote, renameNote, restoreNote, shareNote, sharedNotes, togglePin, undoDelete, unshareNote } from './model.ts'
3	import { type Item, type UndoStore, undoKeyOf } from './undo.ts'
4	import { type UserDirectory, isAdmin } from '../account/users.ts'
5	import { nextNumber, type NoteStore } from './store.ts'
6	
7	const view = ({ archived: _, ...item }: Item) => ({ ...item, sharedWith: [...item.sharedWith] })
8	
9	export function notesResolvers<Env>(implement: Implement<{ user: string }, Env>, undo: UndoStore, users: UserDirectory, notes: NoteStore) {
10	  const { notes: store, owners, added } = notes
11	  const keyOf = (session: { user: string }) => session.user.toLowerCase()
12	  const listOf = (session: { user: string } | null): Item[] => (session ? (store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []) : [])
13	  const ownListOf = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
14	    if (!session) return []
15	    const list = store.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []
16	    store.set(keyOf(session), list)
17	    return list
18	  }
19	  // Times of the adds that went through, per user: at most ADD_LIMIT within ADD_WINDOW_MS.
20	  const ADD_LIMIT = 10
21	  const ADD_WINDOW_MS = 60_000
22	  const recentAdds = (session: { user: string }, now: number) => {
23	    const times = (added.get(keyOf(session)) ?? []).filter((at) => now - at < ADD_WINDOW_MS)
24	    added.set(keyOf(session), times)
25	    return times
26	  }
27	  const forget = (session: { user: string } | null) => {
28	    if (session) undo.delete(undoKeyOf(session))
29	  }
30	  return [
31	    implement(adminUsers, (_, { session, fail }) => {
32	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
33	      if (!isAdmin(session)) return fail('Forbidden', {})
34	      const keys = new Set([...users.keys(), ...[...store].filter(([, items]) => items.length > 0).map(([key]) => key)])
35	      return [...keys]
36	        .map((key) => ({ name: users.get(key) ?? owners.get(key) ?? key, notes: store.get(key)?.length ?? 0 }))
37	        .sort((a, b) => a.name.toLowerCase().localeCompare(b.name.toLowerCase()))
38	    }),
39	    implement(listNotes, (_, { session, fail }) =>
40	      session
41	        ? [...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && item.pinned), ...listOf(session).filter((item) => !item.archived && !item.pinned)].map(view)
42	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
43	    ),
44	    implement(exportNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
45	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', { message: 'Sign in' })
46	      const own = listOf(session)
47	      return {
48	        user: session.user,
49	        notes: [...own.filter((item) => item.pinned), ...own.filter((item) => !item.pinned)].map((item) => ({
50	          title: item.title,
51	          pinned: item.pinned,
52	          archived: item.archived,
53	          createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt).toISOString(),
54	        })),
55	      }
56	    }),
57	    implement(listArchived, (_, { session, fail }) =>
58	      session
59	        ? listOf(session).filter((item) => item.archived).sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)).map(view)
60	        : fail('Unauthorized', {}),
61	    ),
62	    implement(sharedNotes, (_, { session, fail }) => {
63	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
64	      const me = keyOf(session)
65	      return [...store].flatMap(([owner, items]) =>
66	        owner === me
67	          ? []
68	          : items
69	              .filter((item) => !item.archived && item.sharedWith.some((name) => name.toLowerCase() === me))
70	              .map((item) => ({ id: item.id, title: item.title, owner: owners.get(owner) ?? owner })),
71	      )
72	    }),
73	    implement(shareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
74	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
75	      if (!session || !item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
76	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
77	      const clean = name.trim()
78	      if (clean.toLowerCase() === keyOf(session)) return fail('Self', {})
79	      owners.set(keyOf(session), session.user.trim())
80	      if (!item.sharedWith.some((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase())) item.sharedWith.push(clean)
81	      return view(item)
82	    }),
83	    implement(unshareNote, ({ id, name }, { fail, session }) => {
84	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
85	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
86	      item.sharedWith = item.sharedWith.filter((entry) => entry.toLowerCase() !== name.trim().toLowerCase())
87	      return view(item)
88	    }),
89	    implement(archiveNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
90	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
91	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
92	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
93	      item.archived = true
94	      forget(session)
95	      return view(item)
96	    }),
97	    implement(restoreNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
98	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id && entry.archived)
99	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
100	      item.archived = false
101	      forget(session)
102	      return view(item)
103	    }),
104	    implement(addNote, ({ title }, { fail, session }) => {
105	      const items = ownListOf(session)
106	      if (!session) return fail('Invalid', { message: 'Signed out', fields: { title: 'Sign in first' } })
107	      const clean = title.trim()
108	      if (items.some((item) => item.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
109	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
110	      const now = Date.now()
111	      const times = recentAdds(session, now)
112	      if (times.length >= ADD_LIMIT) return fail('TooMany', {})
113	      times.push(now)
114	      const item = { id: notes.nextId(), title: clean, pinned: false, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), archived: false, sharedWith: [], number: nextNumber(notes, keyOf(session)) }
115	      items.unshift(item)
116	      forget(session)
117	      return view(item)
118	    }),
119	    implement(removeNote, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
120	      const items = ownListOf(session)
121	      const at = items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id)
122	      if (at < 0) return fail('NotFound', { id })
123	      if (items[at]?.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
124	      const [item] = items.splice(at, 1)
125	      if (session && item) undo.set(undoKeyOf(session), { item, at })
126	      return { id }
127	    }),
128	    implement(removeNotes, ({ ids }, { session }) => {
129	      const items = ownListOf(session)
130	      const removed = items.filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived).map((item) => item.id)
131	      for (const id of removed) items.splice(items.findIndex((item) => item.id === id), 1)
132	      forget(session)
133	      return { ids: removed }
134	    }),
135	    implement(archiveNotes, ({ ids }, { session }) => {
136	      const archived = listOf(session).filter((item) => ids.includes(item.id) && !item.archived)
137	      for (const item of archived) item.archived = true
138	      forget(session)
139	      return { ids: archived.map((item) => item.id) }
140	    }),
141	    implement(lastDeleted, (_, { session, fail }) => {
142	      if (!session) return fail('Unauthorized', {})
143	      const entry = undo.get(undoKeyOf(session))
144	      return entry ? { title: entry.item.title } : null
145	    }),
146	    implement(undoDelete, (_, { fail, session }) => {
147	      const entry = session ? undo.get(undoKeyOf(session)) : undefined
148	      if (!session || !entry) return fail('NothingToUndo', {})
149	      const items = ownListOf(session)
150	      items.splice(Math.min(entry.at, items.length), 0, entry.item)
151	      forget(session)
152	      return view(entry.item)
153	    }),
154	    implement(renameNote, ({ id, title }, { fail, session }) => {
155	      const items = listOf(session)
156	      const item = items.find((entry) => entry.id === id)
157	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
158	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
159	      const clean = title.trim()
160	      if (items.some((entry) => entry.id !== id && entry.title.toLowerCase() === clean.toLowerCase()))
161	        return fail('Duplicate', { title: clean })
162	      item.title = clean
163	      forget(session)
164	      return view(item)
165	    }),
166	    implement(togglePin, ({ id }, { fail, session }) => {
167	      const item = listOf(session).find((entry) => entry.id === id)
168	      if (!item) return fail('NotFound', { id })
169	      if (item.archived) return fail('Archived', { id })
170	      item.pinned = !item.pinned
171	      forget(session)
172	      return view(item)
173	    }),
174	  ]
175	}

1	import type { Item } from './undo.ts'
2	
3	// Every user's notes, by lower-cased name, with who shared them and when they added them.
4	export type NoteStore = {
5	  notes: Map<string, Item[]>
6	  // Display name of each owner who has shared a note, by store key.
7	  owners: Map<string, string>
8	  // Times of the adds that went through, per user.
9	  added: Map<string, number[]>
10	  // Highest note number ever assigned to a user, so numbers are never reused.
11	  numbers: Map<string, number>
12	  nextId: () => string
13	}
14	
15	export function createNoteStore(): NoteStore {
16	  let seq = 0
17	  const nextId = () => `n${++seq}`
18	  // Entries are given newest first; numbers are assigned oldest first so the first entry ever added is No. 1.
19	  const seed = (notes: [string, string][]) =>
20	    notes.map(([title, createdAt], i) => ({
21	      id: nextId(),
22	      title,
23	      pinned: false,
24	      createdAt,
25	      archived: false,
26	      sharedWith: [] as string[],
27	      number: notes.length - i,
28	    }))
29	  const ada = seed([['Buy milk', '2026-01-15T09:00:00.000Z'], ['Call Bob', '2026-01-14T09:00:00.000Z']])
30	  const bob = seed([["Bob's secret", '2026-01-10T09:00:00.000Z']])
31	  return {
32	    notes: new Map<string, Item[]>([
33	      ['ada', ada],
34	      ['bob', bob],
35	    ]),
36	    owners: new Map(),
37	    added: new Map(),
38	    numbers: new Map([
39	      ['ada', ada.length],
40	      ['bob', bob.length],
41	    ]),
42	    nextId,
43	  }
44	}
45	
46	// The next note number for a user: one past the highest ever assigned to them, never reused.
47	export const nextNumber = (store: NoteStore, key: string) => {
48	  const n = (store.numbers.get(key) ?? 0) + 1
49	  store.numbers.set(key, n)
50	  return n
51	}
52	
53	// Drops everything kept for a user: their notes (archived and shared ones included), sharing, add history and numbering.
54	export const purgeUser = (store: NoteStore, key: string) => {
55	  store.notes.delete(key)
56	  store.owners.delete(key)
57	  store.added.delete(key)
58	  store.numbers.delete(key)
59	}

# Views

```ts
export const Board = ui.view({
  machine: m,        // optional: without it, no ctx / when / events, and 0 JS
  route: home,       // optional: render gets { params, search } typed by the route
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ q: search.q }),   // optional, with machine + route: context fields from the URL
  render: ({ ctx, when, params, search, locale }) => ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl' }, [ /* children */ ]),
})
```
- **Elements:** `ui.<tag>(attrs, children)` for every HTML and SVG element; void tags (`input`, `img`) take only attrs.
  Children are nodes, strings, numbers, data values, and `null` / `false` (render nothing).
- **Classes:** `class` is a static string of Tailwind classes that must exist (HZ026); conditional classes:
  `toggle: { 'bg-indigo-600 text-white': ctx.tab === t }`. No `style`.
- **Conditions:** `ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [ctx.error])`, `item.done ? 'done' : 'open'`.
  By machine state: `when(['adding', 'saving'], [ui.p({}, ['Saving…'])])`.
- **Lists:** `ui.each(items, 'id', (item) => ui.li({}, [item.title]))`. Never `.map` over data.
- **Events:** `on: { click: ui.send(Event, payload) }`; payload fields are literals, data, `ui.dom.value`,
  `ui.dom.form('name')` (submit; `hozu docs forms`).
- **Links:** `ui.a({ href: ui.link(itemPage, { id: item.id }) }, [...])`; never a string path (HZ032).
- **Data:** `ui.query(listItems, input, { ready: (items) => …, failed: { NotFound: () => …, Unexpected: () => … } })`;
  `failed` lists every declared error plus `Unexpected`.
- **Shared UI** (buttons, inputs, fields): `ui.use(Button, { variant, props, on }, ['Save'])` of a kit component
  (`hozu docs components`).

- **Attributes:** HTML names in lower case (`for`, `minlength`, `aria-pressed`, `data-x`), typed per tag. Values are
  literals or data: `'aria-pressed': ctx.show === 'all'`, `title: ctx.error ?? 'OK'`.
- **CSS variables:** `vars: { '--hue': item.hue }`.
- **More conditions:** `list.length === 0 ? ui.p({}, ['Empty']) : ui.ul({}, [...])`; a branch may be a list:
  `open ? [a, b] : null`, also as what a query branch or an each item returns.
  With an enter/leave animation: `ui.if(cond, [then], [else], 'fade')` (the motion name is required).
- **More lists:** `ui.each(tags, null, (t) => …)` for primitives. `.map` only over constants:
  `['a', 'b'].map((k) => ui.option({ value: k }, [k]))`.
- **Text:** template strings work: `` `${n} items` ``.
- **Reuse:** `export const row = part((item: Item) => ui.li({}, [item.done ? 'Done' : item.title]))`, called as
  `row(item)`; it is inlined, so the IR equals the inline form. A plain function that receives data is HZ059.
- **Shared UI:** use the kit component, not a styled `ui.button` per page (`example/` uses a kit).
- **More events:** any DOM event name plus `visible` (entered the viewport). Payload fields also:
  `ui.dom.formAll('name')`, `ui.dom.checked`, `ui.dom.valueAsNumber`, `ui.dom.key`. `ui.dom.value` / `ui.dom.form`
  fill an enum field only from a `<select>`, radios or submit buttons whose literal values are all members (HZ033).
- **Search in links:** the third argument of `ui.link` is optional and exists only when the route declares `search`:
  omitted means every default, and a search lists only the fields that differ: `ui.link(home, null, { show: 'done' })`.
- **More data:** `pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…'])` is optional; a branch may return `null` to render nothing.
  Server-fetched data is sent with the page and never fetched again; after a mutation, queries whose tags it
  invalidates refresh in place.
- **Also:** `ui.html(post.html)` (trusted HTML from query data only, HZ030), `ui.asset(new URL('./x.png',
  import.meta.url))`, `ui.window({ on })` / `ui.document({ on })`, `ui.embed(OtherView)`.

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { admin, archive, deleteAccount, home } from '../../routes.ts'
import {
  Add,
  adminUsers,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  lastDeleted,
  listArchived,
  Restore,
  Cancel,
  Edit,
  EditDraft,
  addedOn,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  listedNotes,
  hasMore,
  selectedCount,
  PAGE_SIZE,
  noMatch,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Save,
  exportNotes,
  Search,
  Share,
  sharedNotes,
  Undo,
  Unshare,
  visibleNotes,
} from './model.ts'
import { text } from './text.ts'

const bulk = ui.formRef()

const errorText = part((code: string) =>
  code === 'duplicate' ? text.duplicate
    : code === 'notFound' ? text.notFound
    : code === 'archived' ? text.archived
    : code === 'tooMany' ? text.tooMany
    : code === 'nothingToUndo' ? text.nothingToUndo
    : code === 'selfShare' ? text.selfShare
    : code,
)

const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ search: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [text.notes]),
      ui.p({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [text.language]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.archivedNotes]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(deleteAccount, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.deleteAccount]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, [text.export]),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [text.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          minlength: 1,
          maxlength: 60,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50' }, [text.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded border bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                  ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, ['Deleted "', deleted.title, '"']),
                  ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, {}) } }, [
                    ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [text.undo]),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (all) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.count({ count: all.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', role: 'search', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                id: 'notes-search',
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': text.search,
                value: ctx.search,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [text.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              'Showing ',
              listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }).length,
              ' of ',
              selectedCount({ items: all, text: search.q }),
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, ['Selected: ', ctx.selected.length]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.archiveSelected]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.deleteSelected]),
            ]),
            noMatch({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search })
              ? ui.div({}, [
                  when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                  when(['idle', 'saving', 'removing', 'pinning', 'archiving', 'undoing', 'restoring', 'sharing', 'unsharing'], [
                    ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, [text.noMatch]),
                  ]),
                ])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                  ui.each(visibleNotes({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search }), 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.input({
                        type: 'checkbox',
                        form: bulk,
                        name: 'ids',
                        value: item.id,
                        'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                        checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),
                        disabled: ctx.busy,
                        on: { change: ui.send(Select, { id: item.id, checked: ui.dom.checked }) },
                      }),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['No. ', item.number]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'flex flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Save, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({
                              name: 'title',
                              'aria-label': 'Edit title',
                              required: true,
                              minlength: 1,
                              maxlength: 60,
                              value: ctx.editTitle,
                              'aria-invalid': ctx.editError !== null,
                              'aria-describedby': 'notes-edit-error',
                              class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1',
                              on: { input: ui.send(EditDraft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
                            }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.save]),
                            ui.p({ id: 'notes-edit-error', class: 'w-full text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.editError]),
                          ])
                        : ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [item.title]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Cancel, {}) } }, [
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.cancel]),
                          ])
                        : ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Edit, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'title', value: item.title }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.edit]),
                          ]),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [
                        'Added ',
                        ui.time({ datetime: item.createdAt }, [addedOn({ at: item.createdAt })]),
                      ]),
                      item.pinned && ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-amber-700' }, ['pinned']),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Pin, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [item.pinned ? text.unpin : text.pin]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Archive, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.archive]),
                      ]),
                      ui.each(item.sharedWith, null, (name) =>
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-slate-600' }, [
                          ui.span({}, ['shared with ', name]),
                          ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Unshare, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'name', value: name }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, ['Unshare ', name]),
                          ]),
                        ]),
                      ),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Share, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), name: ui.dom.form('name') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.input({ name: 'name', 'aria-label': 'Share with', required: true, class: 'w-24 rounded border px-2 py-1 text-sm' }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.share]),
                      ]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Remove, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.delete]),
                      ]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
            hasMore({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }) &&
              ui.a(
                {
                  href: ui.link(home, null, { q: search.q, limit: search.limit + PAGE_SIZE }),
                  class: 'inline-block rounded border px-4 py-2 text-sm',
                },
                [text.loadMore],
              ),
          ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, [text.loading]),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.signedOut]), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, [text.unavailable]) },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        sharedNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (shared) =>
            shared.length === 0
              ? null
              : ui.section({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
                  ui.h2({ class: 'text-xl font-semibold' }, [text.sharedWithMe]),
                  ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                    ui.each(shared, 'id', (item) =>
                      ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                        ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [item.title]),
                        ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['from ', item.owner]),
                      ]),
                    ),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const ArchiveBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: archive,
  render: ({ ctx }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Archive']),
      ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['All notes']),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        listArchived,
        {},
        {
          ready: (items) =>
            items.length === 0
              ? ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, ['No archived notes'])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  ui.each(items, 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [item.title]),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Restore, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['Restore']),
                      ]),
                    ]),
                  ),
                ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…']),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Signed out']), Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Unavailable']) },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const AdminBoard = ui.view({
  route: admin,
  render: () =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.query(
        adminUsers,
        {},
        {
          ready: (rows) =>
            ui.div({ class: 'space-y-6' }, [
              ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, ['Admin']),
              ui.a({ href: ui.link(home, null), class: 'text-sm underline' }, ['All notes']),
              ui.table({ class: 'w-full rounded border bg-white text-left' }, [
                ui.thead({}, [
                  ui.tr({}, [ui.th({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, ['User']), ui.th({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, ['Notes'])]),
                ]),
                ui.tbody({}, [
                  ui.each(rows, 'name', (row) =>
                    ui.tr({ class: 'border-t' }, [ui.td({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, [row.name]), ui.td({ class: 'px-4 py-2' }, [row.notes])]),
                  ),
                ]),
              ]),
            ]),
          pending: ui.p({}, ['Loading…']),
          failed: {
            Unauthorized: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Signed out']),
            Forbidden: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Not allowed']),
            Unexpected: () => ui.p({ role: 'alert' }, ['Unavailable']),
          },
        },
      ),
    ]),
})

export const selectsNote = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [{ send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: true } }],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: ['n1'] } },
})

export const unselectsNote = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: true } },
    { send: Select, payload: { id: 'n1', checked: false } },
  ],
  expect: { state: 'idle', changes: { selected: [] } },
})

export const deletesSelected = contract(notesMachine, {
  given: { state: 'idle' },
  when: [
    { send: Bulk, payload: { ids: ['n1', 'n2'], action: 'delete' } },

# Data: queries, mutations, tags, fn, resolvers

```ts
export const itemsTag = tag({ param: null })                    // tag({ param: z.string() }) → itemTag(id)
export const listItems = query({
  input: z.object({}), output: z.array(Item),
  scope: 'public',                  // 'user' = the session's data (needs project({ session }))
  freshness: 'static',              // | 'request' | { revalidate: seconds } | { swr: seconds } | 'live'
  tags: () => [itemsTag()],          // optional; (input) => [...]
  runs: 'server',                   // where the implementation lives: 'server' | 'browser' | 'either' (required); hozu docs fetch
})
export const getItem = query({ input: Key, output: Item, errors: { NotFound: Key }, scope: 'public',
  freshness: 'static', tags: (k) => [itemTag(k.id)], runs: 'server' })
export const addItem = mutation({
  input: z.object({ title: z.string().min(2, 'Use at least 2 characters') }), output: Item,
  errors: { Duplicate: z.object({ title: z.string() }) },          // optional: declared failures
  invalidates: () => [itemsTag()],                                  // refreshes queries with these tags
  runs: 'server',
})
export const visible = fn({                   // computation: pure JS; may call const/function helpers of this module
  input: z.object({ items: z.array(Item), show: Show }), output: z.array(Item),
  impl: ({ items, show }) => items.filter((i) => show === 'all' || !i.done),
})
```
```ts
export default app({ resolvers: resolvers(project, (implement) => [
  implement(listItems, () => items.map((i) => ({ ...i }))),
  implement(getItem, ({ id }, { fail }) => items.find((i) => i.id === id) ?? fail('NotFound', { id })),
  implement(addItem, ({ title }, { fail, session }) => /* … */ ),
]) })
```
- `runs` is required on every query and mutation. `'server'` resolvers live in `app.ts` (or `features/<name>/server.ts`)
  and get the schema-parsed input; `'browser'` / `'either'` live in `fetch.ts` (`hozu docs fetch`).
- **Query resolvers only read;** writes happen in mutation and endpoint resolvers (see --more).
- User data (`scope: 'user'`) is `freshness: 'request'` or `'live'` only (HZ049); `'live'` needs tags (HZ050).
- Call a `fn` from views or machines: `ui.each(visible({ items, show: ctx.show }), 'id', …)`.

## Details
- A `fn` body may call functions and JSON constants declared in the same module; they are sent to the browser with
  it. Imported names and `let` state are not (HZ047): pass them as input.
- Rendering is derived: `scope` and `freshness` decide static, ISR, SWR, streamed or client rendering;
  `scope: 'user'` data never reaches a cached page (HZ022). A mutation's tags can read only its input.
- Freshness describes how the data changes, not where it is read; choose it per query. `'static'` (with tags) is
  for data only your own declared writers change; `'request'` reads every time it is needed (on the server per
  request, in the browser on mount and on tags; a public one makes its page uncacheable). `'live'` is only for push
  updates.
- `invalidates` drives the refresh: after a mutation or endpoint, cached pages and entries with those tags are
  dropped and the page's queries with those tags are re-read. `endpoint({ …, invalidates: (input) => [tag()] })`
  applies when it succeeds (use POST; a GET write is HZ062).
- Writes from outside (a webhook, a job): `await server.revalidate([itemsTag()])` → `{ entries, pages }`.
- **Why queries only read:** a query that creates a row on read runs again on every request, on prefetch and after a
  delete (the account comes back). Keep two helpers: `listOf(user)` returns the stored list or `[]` for queries;
  `ownListOf(user)` creates it, for mutations only.
- Resolvers in `features/<name>/server.ts` (from the scaffold) are spread into `app.ts`; the input they get has
  defaults and transforms applied.
- Every mutation also has `Invalid` = `{ message, fields }` (input failing its schema, or
  `fail('Invalid', { message, fields: { title: 'Taken' } })`); never declare `Invalid` or `Unexpected` yourself.

- Writes from outside (a webhook, a job): `await server.revalidate([itemsTag()])` → `{ entries, pages }`.
- **Why queries only read:** a query that creates a row on read runs again on every request, on prefetch and after a
  delete (the account comes back). Keep two helpers: `listOf(user)` returns the stored list or `[]` for queries;
  `ownListOf(user)` creates it, for mutations only.
- Resolvers in `features/<name>/server.ts` (from the scaffold) are spread into `app.ts`; the input they get has
  defaults and transforms applied.
- Every mutation also has `Invalid` = `{ message, fields }` (input failing its schema, or
  `fail('Invalid', { message, fields: { title: 'Taken' } })`); never declare `Invalid` or `Unexpected` yourself.

})

Usage: hozu <command> [options]

Commands:
  inspect <feature|id>      Print a feature's canonical IR and summary, or a component (ui.Button) with its uses
  why <target>              What it is, where (file:line), what uses it and what it affects: a declaration
                            (cart.addItem), a component (ui.Button), a state (cart.idle) with its transitions
                            and contracts, a view node (DevTools id or IR pointer) or a page (page:home)
  explain | locate | impact Deprecated: hozu why answers each (removed in 0.15)
  plan <route>              Derived render plan: regions, cache modes, hydration islands
  build                     Write dist/public, dist/server/render.js and dist/manifest.json for deployment
  serve                     Start the app module (project({ app })) on PORT with adapter-node: what npm start runs
  dev                       Start the dev server: reload on edits, hot CSS and Hozu DevTools
                            (--devtools builder|developer picks its mode, --no-devtools hides it)
  requests [done <n>]       The change requests saved from DevTools (--full: all open ones as one prompt);
                            done <n> --result "<what changed>" removes one
  docs [topic] [--more]     Print one topic of the guide, its short form (--more: options and edge cases too);
                            no topic lists them; docs HZ083 prints one diagnostic; docs components adds the app's list
  migrate [--dry-run]       Upgrade the app from Hozu 0.10 or later: rewrite, raise the dependencies, then (run
                            again after installing) compare the IR and check; never writes the lock
  render <id>               Render one component alone (ui.Button): HTML, root class, owned properties, diagnostics
  skill                     Rewrite the agent skill for this Hozu version (--agent claude|agents|both)
  check [--no-types]        Type-check the app and validate it: the one command to run after every edit
                            (--no-types: rules and contracts only)
  map                       Outline the app (routes, queries, mutations, events, states, views) with file:line
  get <path>...             Request pages in-process (no server): status, title, alerts, visible text, forms
  env [--example]           Every env variable the app reads: side, required, default, set now, internal URL;
                            --example writes .env.example
  call <feature>.<effect>   Run one query or mutation in-process (no server) through the app's own handler:
                            --input '<json>', --session '<json>'; a mutation writes real data and needs --write
  browse <path> --do <step> Run the steps in headless Chrome with and without JS (no server): what each step changed
  add feature <name>        Scaffold a working feature (model, views, contracts, resolvers) and wire it in
  add component <kit|feature> <Name> [--client]
                            Add a component to a kit or a feature; --client adds the client module, the app.ts
                            bundle and the @hozu/bundle dependency
  add kit <id> [--sync]     Add a component kit: <id>/kit.ts, <id>/tv.ts (tailwind-merge config from the design
                            system) and project({ kits }); --sync regenerates only the config block

Options:
  --json               Machine-readable output (schemas in @hozu/cli/schema)
  --config <path>      Config file (default: hozu.config.ts)
  --update-lock        check: rewrite hozu.lock.json when there are no errors
  --out <dir>          build: output directory (default: dist)
  --agent <agent>      skill: claude, agents or both (default: the folders that exist)
  --session <json>     get/browse: start signed in with this session (a real one: sign-out works); after --as, that actor's
  --full               get/browse: print the whole visible text and every changed line
  --select <selector>  get/browse: print matching elements with their attributes: button, #id, [role=alert], a[href]
  --forms              get: list the page's forms: fields with defaults, checkbox groups, form= controls, submit buttons
  --do <step>          browse: 'fill <label>=<value>', 'select <label>=<option>', 'check <label>', 'uncheck <label>',
                       'click <name>', 'submit "<form>"', 'press <key>', 'wait <ms>', 'goto <path>' (repeatable, in
                       order); a target may end with in "<text>" (the list item, table row or form containing it)
  --js <on|off|both>   browse: run the steps with JS, without JS, or both side by side (default both)
  --as <name>          browse: the steps after it are this actor's, in its own browser; repeat to switch actors
  --screenshot <file>  browse: save a PNG of the viewport after the steps
  --reduced-motion     browse: emulate prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
  --page <path>        add feature: also add a route and a page at this path
  --with <parts>       add feature: any of detail,toggle,filter,remove,auth (comma-separated)
  --sync               add kit: rewrite the generated block of <id>/tv.ts from the current design system
  --client             add component: a client component (browser code in its own module)
  --variant <k=v>      render: a variant value (repeatable)
  --props <json>       render: the props, a JSON object

## Summary

Implemented change request 22 (per-note pages) in the notes app:

- **New route** `notePage` at `/notes/:number` (`routes.ts`), registered in `hozu.config.ts` with `AccountBar` + a new `NoteDetailView`.
- **New query** `noteDetail` (`features/notes/model.ts`) — server, user-scoped, tagged with `notesTag`, returns the note plus `archived`; fails `Unauthorized` (→ redirects to `/login` via `head.failed`) or `NotFound` (→ HTTP 404) when the number doesn't parse, doesn't exist, or belongs to another user. Added a `noteNumberParam` fn to turn a note's numeric `number` into the string route param (plain `String(...)` on a reference isn't allowed in view code — HZ059).
- **Resolver** in `features/notes/server.ts`: looks up the note only in the signed-in user's own list (`listOf(session)`), so shared notes and other users' notes are never reachable this way.
- **View** `NoteDetailView`: renders `<h1>` title, `No. <number>`, `Added <date>` with a `<time>` element, `pinned`/`Archived` text when applicable, and a `Back to notes` link — no machine, so it works identically with JS on or off.
- **List & archive pages**: each note's title is now a link (`ui.a`) to its `/notes/<number>` page.
- Added `backToNotes`, `noteNotFound`, `pinned`, `noteArchived` strings (en/de) to `features/notes/text.ts`.
- Ran `npx hozu check --update-lock` to accept the new page's head error map; accepted lock line:
  `head notePage: new; now {"NotFound":{"status":404},"Unauthorized":{"redirect":"login"}}`.

Verified with `npx hozu browse` (JS on and off): anonymous → redirect to `/login`; non-existent/non-numeric numbers → 404 "Note not found"; pinned/archived states render correctly; per-user isolation confirmed (ada's and bob's `/notes/1` show different, own notes); sharing a note doesn't expose it via the recipient's note pages or links. `npx hozu check` is clean (0 errors, contracts 6/6, lock current). Nothing appears broken; no server was left running.
